tonle-sap.headline: Open water grew from 2,750 km² to 7,550 km² between the first and last pass.

venezuela-coast.headline: Across the Jun 24, 2026 earthquakes, the ground moved up to 54 cm toward or away from the radar.

mexico-city.headline: The fastest-moving ground here moves about 25 cm a year along the radar's line of sight, roughly 32 cm a year if it is all sinking.

amazon-arc.headline: Radar mapped about 290 km² of new burn scars and clearings, seen through cloud and smoke.

punjab-haryana.headline: At the season's peak (2026-08-18), 80% of the land showed a full crop canopy.

shisper.headline: The fastest ice moved about 6.8 m a day in the latest pair, up from 1.3 m a day in the first.
